description: This file contains the PHP class 'Subscription' in the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Sale' namespace. It handles the admin interface for managing sales subscriptions, including listing, filtering, viewing, and deleting subscription records. It interfaces with model classes to retrieve subscription data and constructs response views with appropriate data and navigation breadcrumbs.
